summary: Owner requested repository setup for commit hooks, privacy and secret scanning, OpenGrep, OpenSSF, alint, Git health reporting and the community profile.

Qualified the isolated checkout against GitHub main. GitHub reports 100 percent community health and private vulnerability reporting is enabled. The existing OpenSSF Scorecard report is 6.4/10 on the audited base.

Python 3.15.2 baseline passed with 367 Python tests and 12 capability skips, 19 station tests, 96 Node tests, and a clean private identifier gate. The installed hook rejected a staged synthetic token and an invalid workflow. TruffleHog 3.100.1 accepted eight exact reviewed URI fixtures, rejected a copy at a new location, withheld raw values and paths, and rejected malformed policy and scanner input. alint, actionlint and strict track health passed. Dependency vulnerability alerts returned HTTP 204 on both enablement and readback.

Two independent panel reviews approved with fixes. Corrected Python and leak-gate setup instructions, validated fixture policy and data, bound both URI scanner fields, withheld source paths, and documented the merge-patch limitation. All changed controls were rerun.

Repository safeguards implemented and locally qualified. Hosted check results and exact-head merge are recorded in the associated pull request. Required status settings are read back after hosted qualification.
